hints.title: Key Insight and Observation
hints.text: A positive integer is evenly good if the count of its even digits equals the count of its odd digits.

hints.title: Algorithmic Strategy and State
hints.text: Such integers must have an even number of total digits 2 * k.

hints.title: Optimal Boundary and Processing
hints.text: Use digit state transitions tracking the current balance difference between even and odd digits.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.notes: Digit DP state tracks (index, balance, is_less, is_started) with d <= 18 digits.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Checking all numbers up to n takes O(n) which is infeasible for n up to 10^18.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Memoization table holds states for small digit lengths.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Formulates digit DP with even-odd count differential state.
